dict.string: QuietType needs microphone access to capture your voice for transcription.
QuietType uses Apple Speech Recognition to convert your speech into text.
QuietType needs Apple Events access to paste transcription results into the active application.
QuietType needs Screen Recording permission to capture system audio (speakers or headphones) in "system only" or "both" mode. No video is recorded.
QuietType needs to capture system audio output (including headphones) for transcribing and translating playback content.
